notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Added voice acting for most characters. 

Quests are now tracked in the HUD from start to finish. 

Shampoo cost reduced to 500 b.

Fixed a bug where the auto-save icon appeared white. 

Convenience update: Moved the parts shelf closer to the drilling machine.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 Community-Inspired
notes.notes:
Added a hidden achievement 

Fixed several minor bugs 

June 18th was allocated for rest, but the community inspired adding an easter egg. Please do not share screenshots of what you encounter, so as not to deprive other players of the joy of discovery.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Added possibility to drink with Tolya after completing the battery quest

Fixed bug with loading active quest

Railway track is blocked when the train departs

Fixed sound bug when drill breaks

Other bugs

Continuing to improve technical condition

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Full English language support added

Main menu refinement

Added new teacup animation

Fixed black screen issue in the final cutscene

Letter interaction: Added ability to retrieve letters after inserting into the door

Passenger train improvements

Achievement "Death" now activates correctly

Fixed HUD sticking issue when pressing Tab

Adjusted volume of sound effects

Other bugs



Thanks to everyone who submitted bug reports

notes.notes:

put a friend on a skewer and have a beer! And you can also go to the sauna!
